title: See you at camp.
intro: Two weeks of campfires, swimming, new friends, and being yourself. Our overnight camp brings LGBTQ+ kids together in the Midwest, with queer counselors and leaders who get them.

heroMedia.alt: Moments of connection and joy at Camp Indigo Point.

supportMedia.alt: Campers and staff supporting one another.

affordability.heading: Let’s make camp possible.
affordability.summary: Money should not be what keeps a kid from camp. We offer partial and full scholarships and work with families to find a way.
affordability.promise: No camper is turned away for inability to pay. If tuition or the deposit is a barrier, talk with Dan about scholarship support.
details: Two-week tuition for summer 2027 is $3,000. The one-week first-time camper option is $1,700.
Register and pay the deposit if you can. Our team will follow up about scholarship needs.
If you cannot pay the deposit, email dan@campindigopoint.org before registering. We’ll help you with the next step.

accommodations.heading: A bunk where you belong.
accommodations.body: Campers live together by grade level, with counselors sharing bunk life. We do not divide bunks by binary gender.
details: Cabins and yurts bring campers together with peers and counselors.
Bunk assignments take grade level and campers’ needs into account.
Private shower stalls and all-gender restrooms are available.
Talk with our team about accommodations and support before camp.

handoff.heading: Here’s the next step.
bullets: Registration opens our official ACTIVE Camps portal. Choose the Indigo Point session that fits your camper.
Complete registration using the portal’s current payment and deposit instructions.
Our team will help with scholarship questions, health forms, and preparing for camp.
Have a question before signing up? Email dan@campindigopoint.org.
